Name: Tool Smart Switch
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod checks when you use a tool whether the tool is appropriate for the target. If not, it will try to switch to another tool in the current
tool bar.

[youtube]kP9adOXzKqA[/youtube]

Tools will switch when used on the following if an appropriate tool exists in the current tool bar:

[list]
[*][b]Stones [/b](Pickaxe)
[*][b]Sticks [/b](Axe)
[*][b]Weeds[/b] (Scythe)
[*][b]Scythe Crops[/b] (Scythe)
[*][b]Dry Tilled Farm Soil[/b] (Watering Can)
[*][b]Artifacts Spots[/b] (Hoe)
[*][b]Trees [/b](Axe if mature, otherwise Scythe)
[*][b]Stumps [/b](Axe)
[*][b]Boulders [/b](Pickaxe)
[*][b]Grass [/b](Scythe)
[*][b]Ore Panning Spots[/b] (Pan)
[*][b]Watering Can Fill Spots[/b] (Watering Can)
[*][b]Pet Bowls [/b](Watering Can)
[*][b]Water tiles[/b] (Fishing Rod) - this is ignored in favour of watering cans
[*][b]Farm Animals[/b] (Shears or Milk Pail)
[*][b]Monsters [/b](Melee Weapon) - only if facing monster, default 128 pixels away or less
[*][b]Tillable Soil[/b] (Hoe)
[/list]
Auto-switching can be tweaked in the config.

You can set a toggle key to turn the mod on and off in the config.

[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
